work.title: The Finiteness Theorem for the Invariants of Finite Linear Groups of Characteristic p
work.author: Emmy Noether

lane.scope_note: Ordinary English translation synchronized to the current German source authority; German is source authority here, not an English usage witness.

concept.intended_sense: the subfield generated by the substitution coefficients, used as coefficient domain for the relative and modular invariant definitions
excluded_senses: a typographic overline without semantic force

target.register: historical mathematical prose in a modern scholarly translation
target.audience: scholarly readers of invariant theory and Noether's collected papers

candidates.definition_or_gloss: unbarred ambient field used by the prior English control
the barred subfield generated by substitution coefficients

source.bibliographic_citation: Emmy Noether, Der Endlichkeitssatz der Invarianten endlicher linearer Gruppen der Charakteristik p, 1926

support.context_window: The relative-invariant factor, modular value system, and finite-field clause all use the barred coefficient field.

weight_semantics.notes: One exact source-control witness; it establishes source meaning, not target-language usage.

source.bibliographic_citation: Printed page 35 of the 1926 Göttingen publication

support.context_window: The printed page visibly bars P in the relative and modular invariant definitions.

weight_semantics.notes: Primary visual confirmation of the source notation; not an English usage witness.

candidate.context_window: The prior English control used the unbarred field in both closing definitions.

weight_semantics.notes: Translation control only; cannot witness native English use or override the source distinction.

adverse.context_window: Using unbarred P erases the source's distinction between the ambient field and the generated coefficient subfield.

weight_semantics.notes: Typed source-fidelity adverse evidence; it is not a negative probability.

sense.notes: The immediately preceding source paragraph defines the barred field from the substitution coefficients.

false_friend.notes: The decision concerns source-locked mathematical notation rather than a cognate.

dominance.notes: English wording does not choose the formula symbol; the source distinction controls it. No cross-family English-neutrality claim is made.

register.notes: The corrected notation is preserved inside historical mathematical prose.

script.notes: The overline renders correctly in the compiled Latin-script English artifact.

source_scarcity.notes: The current German authority and primary printed page independently agree.

source_floor.evidence_or_reason: Current R823 source control and primary printed p. 35 agree.

context_review.evidence_or_reason: The defining paragraph and both affected definitions were reviewed together.

adverse_review.evidence_or_reason: The prior unbarred form is retained as a rejected candidate with explicit source-fidelity adverse evidence.

branch_or_cohort_review.evidence_or_reason: This is a source-locked mathematical symbol correction, not a target lexical or bridge-language selection.

script_policy.evidence_or_reason: The barred symbol is represented deterministically in TeX and visually verified.

internal_qa.evidence_or_reason: The four-page artifact compiled twice without warning/box-error matches and every rendered page was inspected.

external_review.evidence_or_reason: No accepted external or community review return exists; the decision status is capped at internally reviewed.

human_comprehension.evidence_or_reason: No controlled human-comprehension test has been run; no intelligibility certification is claimed.

decision.rationale: Both the current German authority and the primary scan distinguish the generated coefficient subfield as barred P. The prior English unbarred P erased that distinction, so the three closing references were corrected.
decision.reviewer_question: Can a subject specialist confirm that the English surrounding prose makes the ambient-field/subfield distinction as transparent as the notation?

invariants.must_preserve: Every relative/modular invariant reference governed by the defined substitution-coefficient subfield uses barred P.
invariants.may_change: English sentence structure may vary while the field distinction remains exact.
invariants.test: Inspect the three closing definitions against R823 lines 94 and 96 and printed p. 35.

invariants.must_preserve: The corrected TeX compiles and the overline is legible.
invariants.test: Two pdflatex passes, log scan, and page-by-page 144 dpi render inspection.

invariants.must_preserve: German source evidence, English translation control, and internal QA remain distinct provenance roles.
invariants.test: Check evidence source_class and permitted_uses fields.

provenance.notes: No scalar readiness or branch-balance measure was used. External review and human comprehension remain pending.
